cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll find the office biscuits. Leave the delivery email shut; I can work this out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception signed for them. I'll tell everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send everyone downstairs. I'll make the announcement when we're all there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too late. They're downstairs opening the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll bring plates. Tell them to wait before announcing what's in the box.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims deduction leadership, A3 lets B summon people while reserving discovery credit, and A5 offers plates to keep B helping A control the reveal.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 reception delivery redirects A3 gathering; B4 opened box forces A5 to compete for announcing contents instead of locating it.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to tell hungry colleagues and B4 reports they already acted, rather than creating an arbitrary puzzle.

heightening.evidence: A5 narrows the race to naming contents after losing both location and opening.

specificity.evidence: A1 office biscuits and delivery email make reception and the box intelligible without additional history.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 concrete plate offer and one withholding request replace a lengthy boast about who solved the biscuits.
